quotes_target: Cloud Retainer: Guizhong was overpowered by the enemy, and fell in battle
Paimon: Or are you saying that... it was Guizhong? Didn't she, um... already, um...

reason_ko: 「에레보스의 비밀」에서 블러드브랜치 산호가 등장하고 에보시와의 만남이 그려지는데, 「Three Realms Gateway Offering」은 플레이어가 이미 그 산호를 구해 온 일과 그 의미를 아는 것으로 전제하고 이야기를 진행합니다.
quotes_source: That I have appeared before you must mean that the Bloodbranch Coral is in Watatsumi's hands. And a most comforting thought that is.

quotes_source: I am one such sinner — one who has committed the sins of deception and betrayal.
(Enjou transforms into an Abyss Lector)
The Thing Calling Itself "Enjou": Yes, yes, I failed. And we all learned a little something today, didn't we? I suppose you shouldn't trust people that easily in the future, eh?
quotes_target: Paimon: It's him!
The Thing Calling Itself "Enjou": Oh, hey. I would say this is a nice surprise, but... it's really not that surprising.
Paimon: You're just trying to stall for time with small talk again!

reason_ko: 「월광욕 연못」에서 성토(Holy Soil) 현상, 엔카노미야와 뱌쿠야코쿠, 츠유코와의 첫 만남이 소개되는데, 「Three Realms Gateway Offering」은 플레이어가 이를 이미 알고 있다고 가정하고 츠유코·코코미와 함께 이어서 설명합니다.
quotes_source: Tsuyuko: Basically, the bleaching of the soil is said to be due to absorption of the spirit of Watatsumi Island by Byakuyakoku. If it sinks all the way to the bottom, then Watatsumi will become a desert.
Tsuyuko: Just as the human heart runs deep and water flows downhill, the spirit of Watatsumi Island constantly feels the call of Enkanomiya, down in the depths.
quotes_target: Sangonomiya Kokomi: Anyway. I'm sure Tsuyuko will have told you that the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri is a ceremony to reverse the Holy Soil phenomenon on Watatsumi Island.
Sangonomiya Kokomi: But it didn't reverse the Holy Soil phenomenon as expected. Instead, it just... paused. This has never happened before in history.

links: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
reason_ko: 「백석에 파묻힌 흑석」에서 카치나가 밤의 왕국에서 위험에 빠졌다가 이안산, 무알라니 등의 도움으로 구출되고 이안산·시로넨 등이 소개됩니다. 「Tournament of Glory in Bloom」은 카치나의 구출 사건과 이안산, 시로넨, 시틀랄리를 이미 아는 인물로 전제하고 이 사건을 언급하므로 먼저 보는 편이 좋습니다.

Mavuika: Currently, Xilonen of the Children of Echoes, Kinich of the Scions of the Canopy, and Iansan of the Collective of Plenty have all been acknowledged by their Names.
quotes_target: Kachina: So when I finally did, I was over the moon! I mean, things didn't exactly go as planned, and you and the others had to rescue me from the Night Kingdom...
Iansan: Join up with the Collective of Plenty, and I'll provide a year's worth of training sessions and a personalized nutrition plan to help you become stronger than you already are.
Paimon: Granny Citlali! Are you here to take part in the Bloomflower Trials too?

reason_ko: 「영광의 꽃과 태양의 길」에서 무알라니, 아미나, 아테아 등 샘의 부족 인물들과 아비스 습격이 처음 소개되는데, 「Tournament of Glory in Bloom」은 이들을 이미 아는 동료로 전제하고 함께 싸웁니다. 먼저 보면 인물 관계와 배경을 이해하기 쉽습니다.
quotes_source: Mualani: Well, I'm usually the one in charge of the family store, so I'm pretty good at things like renovation and organization.
Amina: On behalf of the People of the Springs, you have my thanks. We're counting on you.
quotes_target: Mualani: Haha, feels just like the old days when we used to fight side by side. We're gonna be unstoppable!
Amina: I can't speak for everyone else, but I can guarantee that Mualani will be there — there's nothing she loves more than a lively occasion.

reason_ko: 「눈보라와 푸른숲의 춤」에서 Nefer가 Curatorium of Secrets의 보스로 처음 소개되고 Traveler와 첫 만남을 갖는데, 「Where Waves Meet the Reef」는 Nefer와 Curatorium을 이미 아는 인물과 조직으로 전제하고 대화가 진행됩니다.
quotes_source: Lauma: Allow me to introduce you. , Paimon... This is Nefer, boss of the Curatorium of Secrets.
Nefer: Pleasure to meet you.
quotes_target: Chevreuse: Given your association with the Voynich Guild, I suspect the boss of the Curatorium might raise some objections if I insisted on bringing you into custody as well.

Nefer: Now that we're on the other side of this incident, I suggest we put any remaining questions to rest here and now. The Voynich Guild won't be responsible for any disputes remaining after this meeting.

reason_ko: 「안개와 어두운 숲을 지나」에서는 콜레이의 질병(에leazar)과 악화되는 상태, 그리고 티그나리가 그녀의 스승으로서 돌보는 관계가 소개됩니다. 「Windblume's Breath」는 콜레이의 병이 나았다는 결과와 티그나리를 스승으로 소개하는 관계를 이미 아는 것으로 전제하므로, 먼저 보면 이해가 쉽습니다.
quotes_source: Collei: Amber knows about my case of Eleazar and what's happened in my past, but I haven't told her about my condition getting worse...
Tighnari: Don't you worry about Collei, I'll look after her. I'll find a way to understand the relationship between The Withering and her disease.
quotes_target: Collei: So ever since my Eleazar got better, I've been looking out for an opportunity to come back to Mondstadt and tell them all the news that I've been cured...
Collei: Sucrose, this is my teacher, Tighnari. He's a highly respected Forest Watcher in Sumeru, and he's also a very famous botanist.

reason_ko: 「영웅의 의식」에서 Och-Kan 폭군 전설, 투른파이어, 성스러운 불꽃, 불의 군주 Xbalanque가 소개되는데, 「불을 거슬러 돌아온 결말」는 플레이어가 이미 이 개념과 인물들을 알고 있다고 전제하고 이야기를 전개합니다.

Kukulkan: Yes. Xbalanque was undoubtedly slain at that time... But he was reborn then, and thus became the so-called god of fire, the Pyro Archon.

reason_ko: 「약속과 망각 사이에서」는 '도둑맞은 불꽃의 현자'와 '용의 선택받은 자'라는 수수께끼를 던지고, 「불을 거슬러 돌아온 결말」는 그 현자가 쿠쿨칸이라는 정체를 밝히며 결말을 보여 줍니다. 또한 B는 플레이어가 이미 현자를 알고 있다고 가정하므로 A를 먼저 해야 합니다.

Traveler: "Chosen of Dragons"...
Paimon: So that Sage was also behind us falling into that place when we first came to Natlan, and is also linked to dragons...?
quotes_target: Traveler: You're... the Sage of the Stolen Flame?

quotes_source: And , I wish you success removing the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing.
Legend has it that long ago, before Xbalanque became the Pyro Archon, it was there that he fought against the Flamelord who wielded the powers of blinding light and searing heat...
quotes_target: Paimon: Anyway, so, is that Flamelord's Blessing gone now? But still has that mark on his head...
One Who Speaks Coldly: Open your eyes, descendant of the Flamelord.

Masseira: Ah, , esteemed Master of the Jinni. To what do I owe the pleasure?
quotes_target: Liloupar: Generally speaking, the master doesn't choose the Jinni. Instead, the Jinni chooses their master. Even should we part ways here, I doubt our connection will be easily severed.
Liloupar: So... please accept this final gift.

Toba: And then, kshhh! The flame dropped into the deathly dark Night Kingdom, where it still burns to this day.
quotes_target: Manqu: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.
Manqu: He obtained no Ancient Name, but Pacal is not to be taken lightly... so long as he's kept his training up these last few years.

reason_ko: 「월광욕 연못」에서 성토(Holy Soil) 현상과 엔카노미야, 심연의 용 등이 처음 소개·설명되는데, 「에레보스의 비밀」은 플레이어가 이미 이를 알고 있다고 가정하고 성토가 용의 서식지 확장이라는 식으로 그 원인을 설명한다.
quotes_source: Tsuyuko: As a result, our soil is slowly bleaching, becoming Holy Soil. If this continues, Watatsumi Island will one day become a desert as pale as the moonlight.
Tsuyuko: The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya. Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.
quotes_target: Eboshi: The Holy Soil phenomenon is, in fact, the expansion of their habitat. That means that the primordial elemental power of the three realms is growing stronger.
Eboshi: Narukami Island even knew us as the "beauties of Watatsumi," renowned for our soft skin, which would conceal seven types of skin blemish...

reason_ko: 「월광욕 연못」에서 에노칸노미야 입구, 와타츠미 오미카미, 심연의 용 후예, 츠유코와의 첫 만남 등이 소개되고, 「백야국 주야기」는 플레이어가 이를 이미 알고 있다고 전제하며 츠유코가 필요로 하는 옥산호 가지를 가지러 가는 맥락을 이어갑니다.
quotes_source: The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya. Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.
We will need to dive down to Enkanomiya and retrieve a Jade Coral Branch left behind by our Omikami, which was used to suppress the Dragonheir of the Depths.
quotes_target: Paimon: Whatever. Let's go get the Bloodbranch Coral that Tsuyuko needs.
Aru: Ah, yes. Now that the Evernight has arrived, all of Enkanomiya will show you a different side of itself. You should meet various afterimages along your path.
Tsuyuko: ...This... This is very grave news. I will report it to Madam Kokomi.

reason_ko: 「황금빛 꿈」에서 제흐트의 아버지 제브라엘이 사무엘과 함께 영원한 꿈속에서 죽고, 제흐트가 그의 유지를 따라 타니트 부족을 찾아가 에터널 오아시스를 지키게 되는 과정이 나온다. 「파도처럼 들이닥친 원수…」는 이 사건과 제흐트의 처지, 타니트 부족, 에터널 오아시스를 이미 아는 것으로 전제하며, 제흐트가 배신자일지 모른다는 이야기를 다루므로 먼저 보는 것이 좋다.
quotes_source: Jeht: I found out that my father is from this tribe called "Tanit"... So, I plan to look for them... Perhaps they can tell me about my father...
Jeht: ...To the Eternal Oasis. I hope they'll find true peace there.
Tirzad: Jebrael... protected us, but he... *sigh*
quotes_target: Babel: Yes. As we now hold the Eternal Oasis, we must prevent all with dubious intent from ever breaching its thresholds. The Tanit stands now as defenders of the Eternal Oasis.
Babel: And the one most suited to complete this task is, to my mind, undoubtedly Jeht. She is guarding her parents, is she not?
Babel: Jeht... Jeht, she's... I hate to say it, but she... could very well be a traitor to the tribe.

reason_ko: 「애증의 헤스페리데스」에서 Aksinya가 처음 정식으로 등장해 Goggles를 만든 사람이자 Eye of Graeae의 조각을 건네주는 인물로 소개되고, Pavlina와의 대립과 그녀의 소멸이 그려집니다. 「눈보라 속으로 추락하는 궁전」는 Paimon이 Aksinya를 이미 아는 사이로 대하고 Goggles의 모든 힘이 회복된 상태를 전제하므로, 먼저 보지 않으면 인물 관계와 상황이 혼란스럽습니다.
quotes_source: Aksinya: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.
Aksinya: Which is to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.
(Pavlina disintegrates into icy mist)
quotes_target: Paimon: A—Aksinya! It's you...!
Aksinya: Yes. I'm glad to see that you remember my name, Paimon.
Eye of Graeae: Yes... Like Miss Paimon says, I have recovered all my power.

reason_ko: 「생명의 거처」에서 Koshchei와 Aksinya가 처음 소개되고 Eye of Graeae(고글스)를 되찾는 목적이 제시되는데, 「눈보라 속으로 추락하는 궁전」는 플레이어가 이미 Aksinya를 알고 있다고 전제하며 그 목적의 결말(Eye of Graeae를 빼앗아 Primordial Human으로 합쳐지는 것)을 보여줍니다.
quotes_source: Aksinya: I am but a lowly "Royal Jester" who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar. My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.
Aksinya: Our goal is the same... to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.
quotes_target: Aksinya: Yes. I'm glad to see that you remember my name, Paimon.
Paimon: ...You know, the one who appeared in that mumbly-jumbly town with the firebird, and in that castle full of Snegovik. Paimon remembers her name was Ak...
Aksinya: You may leave the Eye of Graeae in my keeping for a time. In my estimation, it is a form of homecoming for it anyhow.

reason_ko: 「궁전과 무덤」에서 Zver의 정체와 Goggles(Eye of Graeae)의 기억 상실, 몸이 셋으로 나뉜 사연, Alvis·Domovoy 등의 미스터리가 제기됩니다. 「눈보라 속으로 추락하는 궁전」는 그 답(Goggles가 원시 인간이 되고 Alvis 등이 배신한 이유, Zver의 조롱의 의미)을 보여 주므로 먼저 보는 것이 좋습니다.
quotes_source: "Zver": So you really have no inkling... Ha! That woman was pushed into the Shadow Realm, while your body was split up into three. That is why you don't have all your powers now...
Paimon: Paimon wonders who this "Alvis" is...
Eye of Graeae: Alvis... was the Grand Duke of the Domovoy.
quotes_target: Primordial Human: And so, I incited them to divide me up, to split me into pieces, and to betray Aksinya...
Primordial Human: The "Zver" mocked me, for it believed its mission fulfilled. And I, despite fleeing my duties with all my mind, wound up here all the same.
Paimon: Wait... So that blue algae thing, that Snegurochka, and the Domovoy Grand Duke from Novokitezhgrad... They betrayed Aksinya because of you?

reason_ko: 「약속과 망각 사이에서」에서 '작은 녀석(Little One)'이 처음 등장하고 사우리안을 위협하는 고대 용의 힘과 와욥(Wayob)이 설명되는데, 「용에게 선택받은 자의 여정」는 플레이어가 이 존재와 저주 및 배경을 이미 알고 있다고 전제하고 진행됩니다.
quotes_source: Manqu: Shame. He's such a vigorous little one too...
Manqu: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.
quotes_target: Paimon: Yeah... we've been adventuring for so long, but haven't taken any pictures together! Now that the little one's curse has been lifted, he can finally grow up big and strong!
(Follow Little One to the Embercore Flower)

reason_ko: 「생명의 거처」에서 Koshchei, Aksinya, Primordial Human, Eye of Graeae(고글)의 정체와 Hvergelmir라는 배경이 처음 소개되는데, 「궁전과 무덤」는 이들을 이미 아는 것으로 전제하고 과거 회상을 풀어 갑니다. 먼저 보면 이 인물들과 미스터리의 맥락을 이해하기 쉽습니다.
quotes_source: Eye of Graeae: ...Koshchei the Deathless.
Aksinya: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.
Eye of Graeae: ...an organization called Hvergelmir.
quotes_target: Izmaylov: You are right, Azazel. There is too much to think about.
Eye of Graeae: Regarding Hvergelmir's past status... Do you have any other questions?
Eye of Graeae: They are man-made monsters... created by Koshchei at Hvergelmir back in the day.

reason_ko: 「서리달의 축복」에서 라우마(Lauma)와 문미러(Moon Mirror), 서리달의 후예(Frostmoon Scions)가 처음 소개되고 설명되는데, 「달의 폴카」은 플레이어가 이미 라우마와 문미러를 알고 있다고 가정하고 진행됩니다.
quotes_source: Lauma: Here we are. What you see now is the Moon Mirror, within which the Lunar Semblance is sealed.
Lauma: But to the Moonchanter of that era, and to the Frostmoon Scions of today, it is a priceless treasure.
quotes_target: Paimon: Oh right! Since she's dressed like a Frostmoon Scion, Lauma must know her! Let's ask her about it the next time we meet, shall we?
Verna: Anyway, first things first — let's gather the remaining kuuhenki on the island, extract the last fragment from the Moon Mirror, and stabilize the disturbance once and for all!

reason_ko: 「메로피드의 삶」는 「화가 표류기」에서 처음 소개된 화가 Julien, 개 Pepper, 그리고 Julien에게 능력을 준 "Caterpillar"를 이미 아는 것처럼 대화합니다. 먼저 플레이하면 이들이 누구인지와 Julien의 사연을 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Julien: But this ability to draw things in such exactitude... If Caterpillar had not been the one to grant it to me, I would have named it a curse.
Traveler: Hold on. Who's Caterpillar?
quotes_target: Paimon: Ah, that's right! Julien! The painter we met at Samudra Coast. Do you remember him? So you're the "Caterpillar" he mentioned!
Paimon: Wait, so he was lying? But the painting he made for Pepper looked so real, even though the color was a bit off.

reason_ko: 「네코는 고양이」에서 네코와 그녀가 기다리는 히비키, 도메키가 처음 소개되고 폭풍 속에서 실종된 배경이 설명됩니다. 「세이라이 번개 추적기」는 플레이어가 네코와 히비키를 이미 아는 것처럼 그들을 언급하므로, 먼저 보면 맥락을 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Neko: Hibiki used to say that there were lots of them on that island, and even asked if I would like one made in my image.
Neko: Indeed, that is all the more reason for me to restore this shrine. When Hibiki returns, we shall all eat together.
quotes_target: Neko: Indeed, after that huge, huge storm, Hibiki, Domeki, and the others never returned, either.
Neko: Hibiki unsealed those rocks a good, long time ago. It has much to do with those...

reason_ko: 「약속과 망각 사이에서」에서 와요브와 밤의 나라, 그리고 사우리안이 밤의 나라에 받아들여지는 조건이 소개되는데, 「뭇 산의 그림자」는 이 개념들을 이미 아는 것으로 전제하고 밤의 나라로 이동하는 장면과 리프트하운드를 등장시킵니다.
quotes_source: Manqu: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.
Pacal: If nothing else, I can ensure it will be taken care of until the day it must enter the Night Kingdom.
quotes_target: Titu: *sigh* Were I telling the children a story, I'd say that the Wayob hung the Pins here to pin the shadow of the Volcano Lord in place...
(The Traveler and Paimon are transported to the Night Kingdom)
Paimon: Whoa, why are there so many Rifthounds!?

reason_ko: 「의외」에서 Mr. Nine과 Nicole의 관계, 그리고 『Flowers for Princess Fischl』과 『Legend of the Shattered Halberd』가 처음 소개되고 Mr. Nine의 정체가 밝혀집니다. 「바람 요정의 영검 수행기!」는 플레이어가 이미 그들을 알고 있다고 가정하고 Mr. Nine과 Nicole의 공동 작업을 보여 줍니다.
quotes_source: Nicole: Ah, I see. Well, "Mr." Nine... is right here.
Nicole: So, I tracked down an old Seelie friend of mine, and told her all the stories I was imagining.
Onodera: Well, sure. The author of "Flowers for Princess Fischl," Mr. Nine...
quotes_target: (A cutaway starts, showing Mr. Nine and Nicole in conversation)
Mysterious "Immortal" Being: ...Thus, the dispute between the advocate of textual fidelity and the advocate of narrative necessity — that is to say, the author — remains unresolved.
Mysterious "Immortal" Being: Furthermore, the project bears a certain resemblance to Legend of the Shattered Halberd, and revisions to Flowers for Princess Fischl are still outstanding...

reason_ko: 「「사냥매」 타들라」에서 리루파르가 '진(Jinni)'이자 플레이어가 '진의 주인'으로 불리는 설정과 구라바드의 몰락이라는 떡밥이 처음 소개되는데, 「빌키스의 애가」는 플레이어가 이미 진 리루파르를 데리고 있고 구라바드의 몰락 이야기를 아는 것을 전제로 진행됩니다.
quotes_source: Liloupar: The fall of Gurabad... is just a prologue. I merely revealed what torments await.
Masseira: Ah, , esteemed Master of the Jinni. To what do I owe the pleasure?
quotes_target: Liloupar: That was the root of the farce that ended Gurabad... Though that is a different tale.
Babel: Esteemed Master of the Jinni, whatever you may desire, I will do my utmost to fulfill, if you would only ask.

reason_ko: 「황금빛 꿈」에서 제프트의 아버지 제브라엘이 사말과 함께 죽고, 제프트가 아버지의 부족 타니트를 찾아가기로 결심합니다. 「빌키스의 애가」는 제프트가 타니트 부족에서 지내며 아버지를 그리워한다는 점과 일행과의 친분을 전제하므로, 먼저 보지 않으면 상황이 혼란스럽고 주요 사건이 스포일러됩니다.
quotes_source: Jeht: I found out that my father is from this tribe called "Tanit"... So, I plan to look for them... Perhaps they can tell me about my father...
Tirzad: Jebrael... protected us, but he... *sigh*
Jeht: Father... He was so busy, he never had the time for anything... He didn't leave anything behind, just that axe he always used...
quotes_target: Katheryne: The Tanit are the tribe from which Jeht hails.

Jeht: Still, the first days were rough, and I occasionally thought about the days back when my father would teach and protect me... Hehe, and to think that I used to find him annoying when he was around.
Paimon: But, what's this? "The Tanit camp"? That name sorta rings a bell. Have we been there before?

reason_ko: 「눈보라와 푸른숲의 춤」에서는 세 달의 여신(서리달 등)이 강림자들이 일으킨 전쟁 중 죽었다는 사실과 서리달의 정체가 설명됩니다. 「무인선」은 카논(서리달), 아리아, 소네트 자매와 강림자를 이미 아는 것처럼 다루므로 배경 지식으로 먼저 보면 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Lauma: Next was the Frost Moon... Smaller than her big sister, yet brightest in radiance. Her glow became the cold, undying lantern of the night.
Lauma: Afterwards... Well, as you have seen, the three Moon Goddesses perished.
quotes_target: Aria: But I wasn't talking about that. I mean, I didn't expect you, the "Frost Moon," to have such a sentimental side. It's endearing.
Canon: That Descender's servant said they had matters to discuss with me about this world's gravitational potential and metric tensor.

reason_ko: 「네코는 고양이」에서 세라이 섬과 아사세 신사, 키츠네 사이구, 섬의 수수께끼가 처음 소개되는데, 「안개 바다 기행」는 플레이어가 이미 세라이 섬에서의 의뢰와 말하는 고양이를 알고 있다고 전제하고 이야기를 전개합니다.
quotes_source: Etsuko: Seirai Island... It seems that this place is still full of many mysteries...
Kiminami Anna: There's... an Asase Shrine on Seirai Island, and that shrine is home to a talking cat!? And that cat asked you to make it a meal?
quotes_target: Katheryne: Your deeds on Seirai Island have been reported to me by Miss Eiko. You've done very well.
Paimon: So earlier, we took a commission from the Adventurers' Guild and went to Seirai Island to investigate...

reason_ko: 「세이라이 번개 추적기」에서 시작된 Seirai 섬의 폭풍 조사와 낯선 깃털 발견이 「안개 바다 기행」에서 Thunderbird/Kapatcir의 정체와 깃털의 의미를 밝히는 결말로 이어지며, 「안개 바다 기행」는 플레이어가 이미 Seirai 섬 의뢰를 겪었다고 전제합니다.
quotes_source: Traveler: You know, we also found this strange feather...
Etsuko: Whoever that is, they're responsible for this storm on Seirai Island.
quotes_target: Katheryne: Your deeds on Seirai Island have been reported to me by Miss Eiko. You've done very well.
Paimon: So earlier, we took a commission from the Adventurers' Guild and went to Seirai Island to investigate...

reason_ko: 「최고의 진미」에서 에스코피에가 호텔 드보르의 총괄 셰프 자리를 내려놓고 사바나가 새 총괄 셰프가 되며 둘의 관계가 사제 관계로 정리되는데, 「파도의 변주곡」는 이 변화된 역할과 관계를 이미 아는 것으로 전제하고 이야기를 진행합니다. 먼저 보지 않으면 사바나가 총괄 셰프가 된 경위와 에스코피에가 "단순한 제빵사"로 지내는 이유를 이해하기 어렵습니다.
quotes_source: Escoffier: So, I decided to step down, and look for new opportunities to improve myself.
Escoffier: And you've been head chef now for what, six months? If that? A couple hundred failed attempts, and you're gonna throw in the kitchen towel?
Savanna: ...Come back, Escoffier! Come and be our head chef again! I... I'll never be able to replace you!
quotes_target: Escoffier: But you're the head chef of the Hotel Debord now. Your goal is for customers to hand you Mora and walk away with a cake.
Paimon: Hahaha... Even though she's no longer head chef, Escoffier's tough-love mentorship towards Savanna hasn't changed a bit, huh...
Escoffier: Nope. I'm having too much fun being a simple baker at the moment.

reason_ko: 「바다 거품과 낙화의 브러시」에서 멜루신과 마메르(Mamere)가 처음 소개되는데, 「바다 정령의 선물」는 플레이어가 이미 멜루신들과 마메르를 알고 있다고 전제하고 이야기를 진행합니다.
quotes_source: Mamere: Thank you. Sorry, I made you clean up after me again. Y'know, just like when we met for the first time?
Paimon: Still, looking at how you're packing things up, Paimon can't help but think that you Melusines really have short hands...
quotes_target: Puca: Does it count if we ask Mamere to make a huge painting, and then turn the canvas into pajamas?
Paimon: Wow, it's been a long time since Paimon's seen the Palais Mermonia this busy! Puca wasn't kidding, there are a ton of Melusines...

reason_ko: 「에리니에스의 야생 정령」에서는 파시브가 말하는 '새 시종(New Valet)'이 누구인지가 수수께끼로 남는데, 「바다 정령의 선물」는 그 정체가 느베이예트임을 밝히고 파시브와 이미 아는 사이로 그립니다. 따라서 먼저 보면 이 수수께끼의 답과 둘의 관계를 이해할 수 있습니다.
quotes_source: Paimon: So that's it... But who is this New Valet? And why does he need you to help protect this place, anyway?
Paimon: Gosh, who is this New Valet?
Pahsiv: Fontaine, New Valet, protect.
quotes_target: Traveler: Wait, does this mean the legendary "new valet" is none other than...
Pahsiv: New Valet, Pahsiv! Pahsiv!
Paimon: That's what she meant!? Oh... And to think that it used to keep Paimon up at night, tossing and turning... Even lost sleep over it...

reason_ko: 「백야국 주야기」에서 지바시리(Jibashiri)가 저승의 무장 재판관이라는 설정과 'Before Sun and Moon' 기록에 대한 단서가 처음 소개되는데, 「안티고누스」는 플레이어가 이미 지바시리와 그 책을 알고 있다고 가정하고 이야기를 진행합니다. 다만 주요 사건의 스포일러는 아니므로 배경 설명 수준의 약한 추천입니다.
quotes_source: Enjou: The special officer corps Chthonios, the armed judges of the nether in Byakuyakoku. That's who the "Jibashiri" are.
Enjou: I came here to search for a certain book. That book contains records of things that happened in Byakuyakoku before the Dainichi Mikoshi was constructed.
quotes_target: Paimon: Are you the people who've been suspected of stealing "Before Sun and Moon"?
Antei: The disabled machine crashed on top of the lost book. There's no way to retrieve it now.

reason_ko: 「Bantan Sango Case Files: The Warrior Dog」에서 Ubiquity Net과 Kageroumaru가 처음 소개되고 여행자가 그물을 사용해 보는데, 「사방팔방의 그물」은 플레이어가 이미 그 그물과 사건을 알고 있다고 전제하고 개량판을 다룹니다.
quotes_source: Sango: Ah, yes. I almost forgot. How did you find using the Ubiquity Net?
Ryuuji: Unless I miss my guess, Kageroumaru is now 's ninken.
quotes_target: Sango: Oh, hello there, Traveler. Do you still remember the Ubiquity Net, by any chance?
Sango: Ugh, that Wakamurasaki... I shouldn't have let her know about Kageroumaru...

reason_ko: 「황금빛 꿈」에서 제트와 벤벤이 처음 소개되고 제트의 아버지 자브라엘이 희생되는 사건이 나옵니다. 「재회의 기쁨」는 플레이어가 이미 제트와 벤벤을 알고 있고 벤벤이 무덤 문을 열어 준 일을 안다고 전제하므로, 먼저 보면 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Jeht: Hmm, it is possible. Besides Tirzad, we must protect Benben well too.
Jeht: Benben, stop running off with bad people. Once Tirzad has uncovered all the secrets here, he can head back and write his masterpiece... And you can come home with me and father.
quotes_target: Paimon: Now that Paimon thinks about it, Benben opened the gates to the Mausoleum of King Deshret for us and activated our clearance... It really helped a lot during our journey.
Paimon: Anyway, what happened to Benben? Everything seemed fine the last time we saw it...

reason_ko: 「빌키스의 애가」에서 아지리크가 배신자로 드러나 예흐트에게 죽임을 당하고, 아데르피와의 내통도 밝혀집니다. 「재회의 기쁨」는 아지리크가 실종된 듯 언급하고 아데르피와의 관계를 전제로 하므로, 먼저 보지 않으면 그의 상태와 배신 사건이 스포일러가 되거나 혼란을 줍니다.
quotes_source: Jeht: Kneel, you traitor!
Traveler: He was working with Azariq...
Jeht: Azariq... So he wanted to murder Matriarch Babel, then become the co-leader of the Tanit with me by "marriage"... and then make us all puppets for the northerners?
quotes_target: Fatui Negotiator: And I don't know why, but it seems like Azariq has gone missing too...
Fatui Negotiator: W—We always had dealings with Aderfi... A—And it sounded like the Matriarch of the Tanit had a bias for Azariq... and the new girl.

reason_ko: 「눈보라와 푸른숲의 춤」에서 Columbina(The Damselette)가 Nod-Krai에서 태어난 하피저 겸 달의 여신으로 처음 소개되고 진짜 Frost Moon이 거짓 하늘 너머에 있다는 설정이 설명됩니다. 「달의 화가・세 번째」는 플레이어가 이미 Columbina를 아는 사이로 대하며, 정원에 머무는 그녀와 진짜 Frost Moon에 대한 궁금증을 전제하므로 먼저 보면 맥락 이해에 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Lauma: Judging from what they've said... our Moon Goddess is actually their missing Harbinger — Columbina, "The Damselette."
Traveler: (Is Lauma talking about the false sky? So the true Frost Moon... lies beyond it?)
quotes_target: Traveler: (Columbina is pretty much confined to this garden, now... even though Nod-Krai is where she was born...)
The Damselette: Yes, I would gaze at the sky and wonder... What really lies up there on the true Frost Moon?

reason_ko: 「달의 화가・세 번째」에서 콜롬비나가 달로 떠나는 작별과 달에서 전시회를 열자는 약속이 나오는데, 「달의 화가・네 번째」는 콜롬비나가 달에 다녀온 뒤 변했다는 점과 그 전시회 약속을 이미 아는 것으로 전제합니다. 따라서 먼저 보지 않으면 결과가 스포일러가 되고 상황도 혼란스럽습니다.
quotes_source: The Damselette: Alright. We could hold that art exhibition on the moon, perhaps.
Paimon: Maalaus and the other kuuhenki are really gonna miss you...
quotes_target: Columbina: She's told me that I have changed a lot since returning from the moon.
Columbina: That's half right. We also selected a location for an "exhibition." Do you recall?

reason_ko: 「용기의 여광」에서 Zhiqiong이 소개되고 그녀가 탐험대에서 위험을 무릅쓰며 협곡의 수정을 조사하는 상황이 나오는데, 「거연의 선물」는 여행자가 "Zhiqiong과 함께 마주친 거대한 수정"이라고 말하며 플레이어가 Zhiqiong과 그 사건을 이미 안다고 전제합니다.
quotes_source: Zhiqiong: However, Jinwu and Khedive still need to conduct further analysis on that mysterious crystal's... Uh...
Traveler: Don't worry, I'll take you back.
quotes_target: Traveler: It's the huge crystal that Zhiqiong and we came across.

reason_ko: 「거울과 연기 너머」에서 시타리가 전설의 '그래니 이츠틀리'로 소개되고 오로론이 그녀의 제자라는 관계가 밝혀지는데, 「테노치즈톡 최후의 생존자」은 이를 이미 아는 것으로 전제하고 레일라의 '마스터 오로론'과 '마스터의 그래니' 표현, 시타리의 그래니 이츠틀리 호칭을 사용한다.
quotes_source: Citlali: Besides, Ororon is my apprentice. He might have a few tricks up his sleeve, but I guarantee I know every single one.
"The Captain": Citlali... is said to be the legendary Granny Itztli, someone capable of communicating with the Wayob, and the Wayob are the key to information on the Night Kingdom.
quotes_target: Leyla: Master often calls me "friend" as well, but I won't have it. Master is Master, and Master's Granny is Master Granny. That's just how things are.
Enjou: Oh my, oh my, could it be? The fearsome Granny Itztli, the one who's been chasing me everywhere... When did you get into the customer service industry?

reason_ko: 「영웅의 의식」에서 와요브(Wayob), 번개 영웅 키니치와 그의 고대 이름 말리포를 물려받은 버르키나의 전설, 그리고 키니치에게서 도망친 산카(Sanka)가 처음 소개됩니다. 「테노치즈톡 최후의 생존자」은 이런 개념과 인물을 이미 아는 것처럼 다루므로 먼저 보면 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Trinidad: Burkina was a hero who bore the ancient name Malipo, and Kongamato was a powerful yumkasaur warrior. Together, they fought against the Abyss.
Sanka: Okay, well THAT I am at a loss to explain. How do I manage to stay so chirpy and cheerful? I can only guess it's some kind of powerful magic...
Trinidad: I'm not the one to usually talk about people behind their backs, but I'm convinced the Wayob got hit on the head and took a wrong turn the day it chose to give that ancient name to him.
quotes_target: Citlali: I looked into him a little more and found out he once escaped from Kinich while using a different name, "Sanka"... It turns out he's one slippery rat.
Citlali: Blast! My connection to the Wayob's been severed...
Pucli: That's right. The third was the cunning Sanhaj Kompore, the fourth was the young Burkina, and the fifth was Sundjatta...

reason_ko: 「약속과 망각 사이에서」에서 Wayob와 Night Kingdom이 Saurian을 받아들이거나 거부하는 존재로 처음 소개되는데, 「테노치즈톡 최후의 생존자」는 플레이어가 이미 Wayob와 Night Kingdom의 개념을 알고 있다고 전제하고 이야기를 진행합니다.
quotes_source: Manqu: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.
Pacal: If nothing else, I can ensure it will be taken care of until the day it must enter the Night Kingdom.
quotes_target: Citlali: Blast! My connection to the Wayob's been severed...
Citlali: I'd explain it if I could. Even though I can't sense the Wayob anymore, I can still sense the Night Kingdom's presence... This doesn't make sense...

reason_ko: 「과거의 메아리」에서 베레나타가 소개되고 트루사이트 포션 실험 중 반쪽짜리 반투명 배를 보는 수수께끼가 제기되는데, 「고독한 배의 그림자」은 베레나타를 아는 사이로 전제하고 그 환영 속 배(스폰시안)의 정체를 밝히고 추적합니다.
quotes_source: Traveler: I saw... half of a semi-transparent boat?
Verenata: Okay, now for the next experiment, we'll be testing the Truesight Potion! Are you ready?
quotes_target: Ahes: Verenata told me that you found "that ship" too! Is it true? Is it?
Ahes: Verenata told me! She said that you saw her in an illusion — the Sponsian, she who sails forward eternally! She who's returned from the paradise of Cathuria!

reason_ko: 「Hyperion's Dirge (Quest)」에서 아베라쿠가 여행자에게 신성한 고삐(Divine Bridle)를 건네주는데, 「파에톤들은 모두 춤을 춘다」는 클리메네가 잃어버린 이 고삐를 찾아 달라고 부탁하고 그 입수 경위를 묻는 내용이라 앞선 이야기에서 고삐를 얻은 사실을 전제로 합니다.

quotes_target: Clymene: But alas! It was lost to us long ago.
Clymene: Ahhh... This is the Divine Bridle. The genuine article indeed!
Clymene: I never thought that the day would come when I might lay eyes on it once more. Traveler, tell me — whence did you get this?

reason_ko: 「달의 동쪽, 태양의 서쪽」에서는 다섯 개의 Proof of the Cognoscenti와 Reed Miller의 대보물이 하나의 미스터리로 제시되고, Brahe가 Reed Miller를 사칭했다는 사실도 드러납니다. 「갈까마귀의 계보」는 보물이 흩어져 있다는 이야기가 Brahe의 조작이었다는 점과 Reed Miller의 정체가 Avrelian이라는 점을 밝히며 그 미스터리의 결말을 보여 주므로, 먼저 보지 않으면 핵심 반전이 스포일러가 됩니다.
quotes_source: Ultimate Calamity: Young Solovei tried to stop it, and Brahe, who impersonated Reed Miller.
I must retrieve the Proof of the Cognoscenti from them and find Reed Miller's Great Treasure, so that his name, now forgotten, will be held in esteem once more throughout the world!
"To Miss Grazina: Should you ever wish to leave this place, please give this item to a member of the Treasure Hoarders. They will guide you to me." — Master Thief Reed Miller
quotes_target: Let people believe that the Proof of the Cognoscenti still lies scattered across every corner of this continent, waiting to be gathered by those fortunate few chosen by fate.
Rumors about "Proof of the Cognoscenti" have been spread.
Paimon: Huh!? You mean that was the legendary thief, Reed Miller? Paimon would never have guessed by looking at him...

reason_ko: 「약속과 망각 사이에서」에서 화염군주의 축복 표식과 이를 정화하기 위해 화산에서 두 토큰을 모아야 한다는 설정이 소개되며, 「가야 할 길」는 플레이어가 이미 이를 안다고 전제하고 토큰 수색과 표식 제거를 이어갑니다.
quotes_source: Manqu: That is not a mark that an ordinary Saurian would bear. In truth, records indicate this to be the "Flamelord's Blessing".
Manqu: Remember what we spoke of before? To remove the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing, you need to bring the two required token types to the volcano.
quotes_target: Manqu: Thank you once more, and Paimon. I wish you a safe journey...
Manqu: I know... But as for clues about the tokens' whereabouts, well, I'm all out. I haven't the slightest idea where the other one might be.

reason_ko: 「타타라 모노가타리」에서 토라노스케와 처음 만나고 하ンベ이가 스메르 주재관으로 승진하며 요스케가 용광로 관리를 맡게 되는데, 「《제7의 무사》」는 이 결과를 이미 아는 것으로 전제하고 "Tatara Tales"를 함께 연기한 추억과 토라노스케를 지인처럼 다룹니다.

Toranosuke: They have thus decided to appoint Sir Hanbei to the post of foreign attaché to Sumeru.
Xavier: Alright then. You know the drill, Traveler...
quotes_target: Toranosuke: Ever since Sir Hanbei's "promotion," Yousuke has taken over as the person in charge.
Xavier: I'll always remember that "Tatara Tales" that we acted in together.
Traveler: To think that Mr. Toranosuke would have time...

reason_ko: 「월광욕 연못」에서 쓰쓰코가 엔카노미야의 입구, 열쇠, 고료 마쓰리 의식을 처음 설명하고 열쇠를 얻는 과정을 다루는데, 「고요한 물의 흐름」는 열쇠를 이미 얻어 엔카노미야가 깨어나고 있다는 전제로 시작하며 여행자와 쓰쓰코가 구면인 것처럼 진행됩니다. 따라서 먼저 플레이하지 않으면 상황을 이해하기 어렵습니다.
quotes_source: Tsuyuko: Haha, just call it the "Key of the Deep." We're not going to insist that outlanders use all the proper names for every last thing.
Tsuyuko: The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya. Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.
quotes_target: Tsuyuko: We did obtain the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, yes, and Enkanomiya is slowly awakening. However, we are quite short on manpower. As such, our investigations are proceeding at a slow pace.
Paimon: Paimon wonders how Tsuyuko's preparations are going. Has the way to Enkanomiya opened already?

reason_ko: 「신이 사랑하지 않은 설국」에서 로코트(Rokot)와 스네즈나그라드 베체, 보댜니차 등이 처음 소개·설명되는데, 「여왕의 새 초상화」는 로코트 일원이 차르비차의 특사가 되었다는 사실과 보댜니차·알료샤의 관계를 이미 아는 것처럼 다룹니다. 먼저 보면 배경 이해에 도움이 됩니다.
quotes_source: Vodyanitsa: As for Lelek... You won't have heard of him yet. He's currently the most famous member of the Rokot... Well, more like infamous.
Vodyanitsa: She's just rephrasing what Mr. Pantalone said. The Rokot are the critics he accuses of taking no responsibility for their actions.
quotes_target: Vodyanitsa: Gotta say, I was pretty surprised by your letter, you two! A member of the Rokot serving as the Tsaritsa's special envoy?

Alyosha: Snezhnaya is covered in snow, even during the spring, so we commissioned an artist from Fontaine to bring our vision to life. We didn't even use all the funds... Guess I'll give the rest to the Rokot.

reason_ko: 「긴 밤의 서막」에서 일루가가 분대장으로 처음 소개되고 플레이어가 그의 분대 '나이트메어 오리올즈'에 정식 합류하며 '교수'(Professor)라는 존재가 설명됩니다. 「악행의 대가」는 플레이어가 이미 일루가 분대의 일원이라는 점과 이 괴물에 대한 배경을 전제로 대화합니다.
quotes_source: Illuga: I hereby officially invite you to join my Investigation Squad, the Nightmare Orioles.
Illuga: By the "Professor," do you mean the fiend who was sealed within Kipumaki Cliff five hundred years ago by the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions?
quotes_target: Paimon: We're not quite the "outsiders" you think, hehe. and I are already card-carrying members of Illuga's squad.
Janusz: To earn Captain Illuga's approval... You two really are extraordinary. But when it comes to that monster, knowing too much might not necessarily be a boon.

reason_ko: 「월광욕 연못」에서 엔카노미야와 바쿠야코쿠, 그리고 심연의 용 일족(Dragonheir of the Depths)의 배경이 처음 소개되는데, 「3색 파일」은 플레이어가 이를 이미 알고 있다고 가정하고 "Enkanomiya's last day"나 "Once everyone leaves Byakuyakoku" 같은 말을 한다. 따라서 먼저 보면 맥락을 이해하는 데 도움이 된다.
quotes_source: And the underwater nation of Byakuyakoku was henceforth named Enkanomiya, in juxtaposition to our new homeland Sangonomiya, which stood high above the ocean surface.
The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya.
quotes_target: ???: Hmph. This is the third group of people you've sent here on Enkanomiya's last day.
???: Once everyone leaves Byakuyakoku, the Bathysmal Vishaps will be let loose. These have been raised to react to a special kind of elemental energy.

quotes_source: Jazari: With his achievements, he would have become a sage sooner or later. But he met with an accident during an expedition, and his research results were lost.
Jazari: Exploring the Ruin Golem from the inside seems to be the only solution, and I am presently looking for a way in.
quotes_target: Paimon: But he also said Pir Kavikavus got into an accident on an expedition and all his key findings were lost.
Paimon: But he wasn't making headway until we finally got into the Ruin Golem with him last time.
Jazari: Not only have records of Pir Kavikavus's long-lost research been recovered, but now I'm testing his theory, and it was a success.

reason_ko: 「가르시아의 찬가」에서 Garcia와 Lutong이 처음 소개되고 숫자 기계(Numbering Machine) 연구와 수메르행 계획이 나오는데, 「그의 생명은 저편에」는 플레이어가 이들을 이미 아는 지인이며 수메르에서 기계 개발을 도왔다는 점을 전제로 이야기를 진행합니다.
quotes_source: Lutong: I am Lutong, and this is Garcia, my boss, who hails from Fontaine.
Lutong: Mr. Garcia is currently developing a... I believe he calls it the Numbering Machine.
Lutong: Indeed. Mr. Garcia wishes to read up on some resources at the Akademiya, and I have been hired to go with him.
quotes_target: Lutong: Truly an unexpected meeting, . We never imagined we'd see you in Fontaine.
Lutong: Let me start from the beginning. Since you helped us with the Numbering Machine in Sumeru, its performance has come on leaps and bounds.

reason_ko: 「가르시아의 찬가・맞춤형 선물」에서 Kaia가 처음 소개되고 Garcia와 가까워지며 작별하는데, 「그의 생명은 저편에」는 두 사람이 이미 아는 사이이며 지난번 이별과 악보 선물을 전제로 대화합니다. 이 관계와 배경을 먼저 알아야 이해가 쉽습니다.
quotes_source: Kaia: I see. You have found another way to make a living before I leave, huh?
Kaia: This is not a "failed piece." This is your gift to me. I love it, and I'll keep it.
Garcia: Do you think we'll meet Ms. Kaia again in the future?
quotes_target: Paimon: How do you know Garcia so well, Ms. Kaia? You haven't seen each other for so long...
Kaia: All the more reason for me to come with you! Or are you intending to abandon me again like last time, left holding nothing but a composition with neither beginning nor end?
Paimon: J—Just like in Sumeru, Kaia completely steamrolled Garcia...

reason_ko: 「오래된 몸과의 이별」에서 Qiqi가 좀비이며 Baizhu가 Bubu Pharmacy의 주인이고 뱀 Changsheng이 말하는 존재라는 점이 처음 소개되는데, 「마녀의 계시・강시」은 Qiqi의 좀비 정체, 명령(orders), 보호자 Baizhu와 Changsheng을 이미 아는 것으로 전제합니다.
quotes_source: Qiqi: Once upon a time, Qiqi died. Then, Qiqi was saved by the adepti. Now, Qiqi is a zombie.
Baizhu: Ah, how rude of me. I'm Baizhu, boss of the Bubu Pharmacy.
Baizhu: Hahaha, don't mind Changsheng, she's a good girl, really.
quotes_target: Paimon: Hehe! Quick thinking! If Qiqi had said she was a zombie, it might've scared her half to death!
Changsheng: Perhaps you should prescribe yourself some medicine to stop you overthinking... There's still plenty of time left until her orders say to be back.
Blathine: Aha! Well, that checks out! I'll take Qiqi back to Yilong Wharf right away. Dr. Baizhu is Qiqi's guardian, is he? He must be worried sick!

reason_ko: 「이야기라는 이름의 마법」에서 바르벨로스의 예언이 처음 소개되고 설명되는데, 「마녀의 계시・강시」은 플레이어가 이미 그 예언과 그 안에 등장하는 인물들을 안다고 가정하고 치치가 그중 한 명이었는지 언급합니다.
quotes_source: After learning of Miss Barbeloth's prophecy, Durin and I finally came up with a way to settle the Dragonspine-Durin problem for good.
quotes_target: Traveler: Wait... Those people in Barbeloth's prophecy...
Traveler: Wasn't Qiqi one of them?
